title: termal_send_to_session refuses a remote-root session ("400 Bad Request: target must be a local root session"), so there is no supported mailbox route from the Windows host to a MacBook Pro session
outcome: A coordinator on one host can send a routine mailbox message to a known active remote-root session on a federated host, through a supported, documented route, or gets a refusal that names that route.
acceptance: termal_send_to_session refuses a remote-root session ("400 Bad Request: target must be a local root session"), so there is no supported mailbox route from the Windows host to a MacBook Pro session is done
